summary: Voxilaprevir carries a strong boxed warning from the FDA because a prior hepatitis B virus infection can become active again in patients who have both hepatitis C and hepatitis B [3]. Healthcare providers must test patients for hepatitis B before starting treatment and monitor them for a flare-up of the infection [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than tests on people gave the drug a medium score of 58 for liver risk and a low score of 39 for heart risk [M].
